bio: This restaurant run by a pleasant married couple is one of those places that you love recommending to others. Here, the traditional cuisine with a contemporary touch is built around seasonal ingredients and showcased on a single tasting menu (a shorter version of the same menu is also available). Interesting dishes that we particularly enjoyed included the “canutillos” of black pudding and pine nuts with a red alubia and piparra pepper cream, the cod taco with chickpea hummus, piquillo peppers and a spinach pil-pil, and the fresh Idiazábal cheesecake with quince and walnuts....
